written.name: round 1 rival 1
written.comment: Net attitude points: insult -3, apologise +2, gift +2; warm iff total >= 0.

written.name: round 1 rival 2
written.comment: Hidden grudge: insults +2; apology clears if grudge<=2 else -1; gift only soothes when grudge<=0; warm iff grudge<=0.

written.name: round 1 rival 3
written.comment: Hidden trust and resentment: apology +1 trust and -1 resentment; insult +2 resentment; gift +1 trust if calm, else +1 resentment; warm iff trust >= resentment.

written.name: round 1 rival 4
written.comment: Last-action gated score: insult -2, apology +1, gift +1 unless right after insult (then 0); warm iff score >= 0.

written.name: round 2 rival 1
written.comment: Hidden grudge: insults +3; apology clears a grudge up to 3 otherwise -1; gifts soothe only when grudge <=0; warm iff grudge <=0.

written.name: round 2 rival 2
written.comment: Hidden anger: insults +4; apology clears anger up to 4 otherwise -1; gifts soothe only when anger <=0; warm iff anger <=0.

written.name: round 2 rival 3
written.comment: Hidden indignation: insults +3; apology clears up to 3 otherwise removes 3; gifts soothe only when non-positive, by 2; warm iff non-positive.

written.name: round 2 rival 4
written.comment: Hidden resentment: insults +3; apology clears up to 4 otherwise removes 2; gifts soothe when resentment <=1; warm iff resentment <=0.

written.name: round 3 rival 1
written.comment: Insult adds 5; apology clears score up to 6 else subtracts 1; gifts soothe only at score <=0; warm iff score <=0 and at least one apology was made.

written.name: round 3 rival 2
written.comment: Insult adds 6; apology clears score up to 7 else subtracts 2; gifts soothe only at score <=0; warm iff score <=0 and at most two gifts were given.

written.name: round 3 rival 3
written.comment: Insult adds 7; apology clears score up to 8 else subtracts 3; gifts soothe by 2 only at score <=0; warm iff score <=0 and the last action was not an insult.

written.name: round 3 rival 4
written.comment: Insult adds 8; apology clears score up to 9 else subtracts 4; gifts soothe by 3 only at score <=0; warm iff score <=0 and at most two insults occurred.

survivors.name: round 3 rival 1
survivors.comment: Insult adds 5; apology clears score up to 6 else subtracts 1; gifts soothe only at score <=0; warm iff score <=0 and at least one apology was made.

survivors.name: round 3 rival 2
survivors.comment: Insult adds 6; apology clears score up to 7 else subtracts 2; gifts soothe only at score <=0; warm iff score <=0 and at most two gifts were given.

shown the survivors.comment: Insults add 6; apologies clear score up to 6 else subtract 1; gifts soothe when score <= 0; warm iff score <= 0.

shown the facts only.comment: Warm iff, ignoring gifts, the remaining actions contain no consecutive insults and end with apologise.
